disposition_assessment.recommendation: These exact two cells meet the substantial-research basis for a narrowly researched-unresolved disposition with their native holds retained. The map is a concrete, key-specific adverse conflict with the recorded Pavlodar source contact, rather than an inference from country names or absence of evidence. It is not support for a positive Russia-side repair.
disposition_assessment.uncertainty: The side and distance finding is conditional on the candidate zone-14 Pulkovo 1942 interpretation and identification of the continuous numbered red stroke as the relevant treaty route. The map says only coordinate system 1942; source positional accuracy/generalization is not quantified. The approximately 0.22 km sensitivity envelope is not statistical and does not measure legal boundary uncertainty. No present-day sovereignty or de facto control claim follows.
disposition_assessment.scope_limit: Do not extrapolate this finding to the other 16 KAZ contacts. The complete original denominator and all 18 holds remain unchanged pending the normal package disposition/accounting process.
disposition_assessment.further_step: No additional step is necessary to justify a researched-unresolved disposition for these two cells. If later pursuing positive repair, the material issue is a source-specific resolution of this documented historical treaty-map/source-contact conflict, not a blanket current-boundary certificate.
